content.text:
I can’t complete the booking on your behalf from here, but I can help you pick and book it quickly.

**This Friday is June 12, 2026.** For **2 people, Friday night, downtown Chicago**, good Italian options with online reservations include:

1. **Acanto Restaurant + Wine Bar** — Loop/Millennium Park area; Italian, good for dinner/pre-theater. Open Friday until 11:00 pm. ([opentable.com](https://www.opentable.com/r/acanto-chicago?utm_source=openai))  
2. **RPM Italian** — River North; popular upscale Italian with reservations through Lettuce Entertain You. ([lettuce.com](https://www.lettuce.com/restaurants/rpm-italian/?utm_source=openai))  
3. **The Village / Italian Village** — classic downtown Italian-American spot; takes online reservations. ([thevillage-chicago.com](https://www.thevillage-chicago.com/?utm_source=openai))  
4. **Petterino’s** — Loop/Theater District; Italian-American, reservations available. ([tripadvisor.com](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g35805-d427818-Reviews-Petterino_s-Chicago_Illinois.html?utm_source=openai))  

If you want the simplest choice, I’d try **Acanto at 7:00 or 7:30 pm** first because it’s very centrally located downtown and reservation-friendly.

To finish the reservation, I’ll need:
- Preferred time: **6:00, 7:00, 7:30, 8:00, or later?**
- Name for the reservation
- Phone/email, if the restaurant requires confirmation
- Any preferences: outdoor/patio, quiet table, anniversary/birthday, dietary restrictions?
